rationale.edition: Checked the changed file paths in changed_files.txt: every path lives under web/src/, src/config/, scripts/translations/, or tests/ui-testing/. None fall under enterprise-owned directories (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/, or o2-enterprise-only modules), and there are no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) in the paths or symbols. Anomaly detection alerting is an open-source feature, so the edition is oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty, so there is no explicit opt-out label/comment. The change is user-facing: AnomalyDetectionConfig.vue rewrites the sensitivity control (a read-only Auto level readout with lifecycle states, and a manual level input that only renders for non-Auto tiers), and AlertConfigSummary.vue / anomalySummaryGenerator.ts change how a learned sensitivity is presented.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The user-visible behavior that needs verifying is the new Auto sensitivity readout (Auto level / Current level / Last trained level across training, failed, retraining, and trained states), the manual level input appearing only for non-Auto tiers, the Custom sensitivity label, and the new manual-level validation (a cleared/out-of-range draft blocks saving and shows the range error).
rationale.area: Area is Alerts. The bulk of the UI change is in web/src/components/anomaly_detection/steps/ and web/src/components/alerts/, and the existing (and modified) E2E spec lives at tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js, matching the Alerts sibling folder.
rationale.group: playwright_group is Alerts: in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_cloud.json the 'Alerts' testfolder shard (actual_folder 'Alerts') is the group that references alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js (currently in its disabled list due to the HTTP-receiver callback constraint, not because it belongs elsewhere), so it is the closest existing shard for this spec.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff modifies a Playwright E2E spec — tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js — which is extended to assert the new read-only Auto level readout, the manual level input being hidden under Auto, the Custom sensitivity label, and the trained-model-required hint. These E2E changes directly cover the new feature, so existing_tests_in_diff is true and the route is enhance. The many web/src/**/*.spec.ts Vitest unit specs in the diff are unit coverage and do not count as E2E coverage.
